title: Node kanbusCommandEnv: preserve KANBUS_NO_DAEMON if already set
description: SD soft nit on #259: Node kanbusCommandEnv always sets KANBUS_NO_DAEMON=1; should preserve an existing value when already set (escape-hatch parity with kbsc).
right_now_summary: The Node environment handling still overwrites an existing KANBUS_NO_DAEMON value.
